titulo.alumno:
«Будущее: процесс или завершение»
Future: process or completion

intro: The imperfective forms the future with быть + infinitive: буду читать. The perfective forms a simple future: прочитаю.

frases.alumno: Tomorrow I will be cooking dinner.
By eight o'clock I will have cooked dinner.

piezas.titulo: The imperfective forms the future with быть + infinitive: буду читать. The perfective forms a simple future: прочитаю.
texto: The imperfective forms the future with быть + infinitive: буду читать. The perfective forms a simple future: прочитаю.
The simple future of a perfective is not the present; contrast it with the compound imperfective future.

pregunta.texto: Which sentence promises a complete result?

opciones.explicacion: Приготовлю presents the dinner as an expected result.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Завтра я буду готовить ужин.»

opciones.texto: Tomorrow I will be cooking dinner.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: By eight o'clock I will have cooked dinner.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.
